chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Haul Control to all couriers — the Vane Street corridor is open again. Lanes four through nine, keep it under two hundred.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: We have a manifest mismatch on the Kessel drop. If that box is warm, it is not my problem.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: PULL UP, COURIER. PULL UP. YOU ARE INSIDE THE STACK.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Shift change in ten. Whoever is on the roof at Ardent, the beacon is out again. Still.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Somebody has parked a freighter across two of my lanes. I am told this is temporary. I am told a lot of things.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Weather is closing the upper approach at Pale Terrace. If you are booked up there, you are now booked somewhere else.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Courier, your parcel is logged and the pad is holding for you. Try not to make them wait.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Logged. Clock's running. Try to look like you've done this before.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: That's on your manifest now. Whatever it is.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Confirmed. Lane's clear as far as I can see, which is not far.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: You've got it. Sealed, weighed, and none of my business.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Accepted. They asked for someone reliable. I sent you anyway.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Booked. Take the high lane, the low one's a car park.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: On the board and off my desk. Go.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Nice run. Credits are clearing now. Don't spend it all in the Ribs.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Signed for. Money's moving. Slowly, but it's moving.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Delivered and closed. That's one thing today that went where it was supposed to.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Paid. They didn't complain, which from them is a compliment.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Clean drop. I'm marking you as competent. Don't make me change it.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Received in one piece. Credits inbound. Enjoy the four minutes before you need them.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Logged, paid, forgotten. That's the job.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Done. There's more where that came from, unfortunately.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Air Division, routine sweep, lanes one through six. Nothing to see. As usual.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Unregistered hauler in the Lantern Quarter, descending. We are aware. We are not interested.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Courier craft, you are flying a lane you are not licensed for. Consider this the friendly version.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: HOLD YOUR ALTITUDE. HOLD IT. DO NOT DESCEND.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Cargo seizure at pad nine. Owner declined to attend. Owner never does.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Break off pursuit, we lost him in the smog band. Log it as weather.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: You're on the understack. If you can hear me, you're too low, and that's exactly where I want you.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: They say the Pale Terrace towers are empty. Forty floors, every light on, nobody home. Ask yourself who's paying that bill.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Couriers — if a client won't tell you what's in the box, that's not a red flag. That's a pay rise. Charge accordingly.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: THEY ARE NOT CLOUDS. THEY HAVE NEVER BEEN CLOUDS. LOOK UP.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Anyway. Rain until Thursday. Fly low, fly rude.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Tallow Nutrient Paste. Nine flavours. All of them are paste.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Breathing shouldn't be a luxury. At Ardent Air, breathing is a subscription. That's better.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Kell's Rest. Sleep four hours, wake up owing nothing. Terms apply. Many terms apply.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: New from Vantage Optics — see the sky the way it used to be, for eleven credits a month, forever.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: EVERY UNIT MUST GO. EVERY UNIT. WE ARE NOT COMING BACK.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Drownings Reclamation. We buy anything. We do not ask.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Mayday, mayday — cell's gone, I'm at ninety metres and dropping, anyone on this band —

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: I AM IN THE SMOG BAND. I CANNOT SEE THE LANE. I CANNOT SEE THE LANE.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: It's not an emergency yet. I'm just saying it might be. In about a minute.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: GET OFF THE PAD. GET OFF THE PAD NOW.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Cancel the mayday. I found a ledge. It'll do.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Atmospheric bulletin. Particulate density high below one hundred metres. Visibility, four hundred. Conditions are within normal.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Precipitation across all districts for the next nine hours. Surface reflectivity elevated. Reduce approach speed.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Daylight index, zero point two. This is the maximum for today.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Electrical activity above three hundred metres. Craft in the upper lanes should descend. Craft that cannot descend should continue.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: The smog band has lifted to one hundred and forty metres. Enjoy the view.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Third time at this pad and the lift's still out. I'm carrying it up. Forty floors. Somebody owes me a drink.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Market's open on the Gantry until two. Bring your own light, the strip's been dead since spring.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Anyone flying past Sixteen Low — is that a fire or is that just Tuesday?

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Tower maintenance, block nine. We are aware the beacon is out. We have been aware for some time.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Taxi four-one-one, off shift, going home. Whoever's got the Lantern run tonight — good luck, and I mean that.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: My kid asked what the sky looks like. I said grey. She said what's grey. Fair question.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: GET IT OFF THE EDGE. OFF THE EDGE. IT IS NOT SECURED.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Understack, if you're listening — play the one about the windows again. It's been a week.
